title: catscan result (schema 1)
description: One JSON Lines object per input. New fields may be added in minor versions; renaming or removing one needs a schema bump.

price_exempt.description: price: amounts exempt from the price rule as crossed-out "was" prices; null when the price rule did not run.

pseudo.description: The run checked a pseudo-localized build (--pseudo); absent otherwise.

text.description: The text record (results files). null when nothing was read (error, needs-reader, unsupported, missing, video); absent with --text-record none.

change.description: This input's cell against --baseline; null without one and for text: null.

engine.description: null only for a missing entry.

screen.description: Screen id from --refs or --layout; null otherwise.

device.description: Device label from --device or a {device}/ layout; null otherwise. Absent in envelopes written before it existed.

platform.description: The device label's first token when it names a platform; null otherwise.

text_size.description: Text-size label from --text-size or a {text_size}/ layout; null otherwise, which a cell key reads as default. Absent in envelopes written before it existed.

device_profile.description: fit only: the device profile the image was checked against; null when none matched (device-unknown).

ids.description: Every profile of this size with the same zones, or the candidates intersected (device-ambiguous).

orientation.description: landscape: the side is unknown, so the cutout was skipped; portrait-upside-down (a sidecar from uiautomator rotation 2): the cutout was skipped.

version.description: The shipped profile table version; null for a profile file.

reasons_run.description: fit only: the reasons checked on this image.

reasons_skipped.description: fit only: the reasons not checked on this image, and why.

cause.description: boxes-missing: wrapped or orphan on an image with no sidecar.

host.description: null only for a missing entry.

inventory.description: check --all-keys only: which catalog strings the image shows, sorted by key.

video.description: video only: the take, upright; null when the file could not be opened.

frames.description: video only: the number of recognized frames.

samples.description: video over serve with frames: true; the CLI prints them as video-frame lines instead.

text.description: The line read (signal boxes) or the element text (signal elements); null for a graphic element.

confidence.description: null for a graphic element (signal elements).

element.description: signal elements: the element from the boxes file.

box.description: [x, y, width, height], normalized 0..1, origin top left, 4 decimals.

contrast.description: contrast only: the line's measurement, or why it was not measured.

uncertain.description: The split separated poorly or the ink is two colours: never a finding.

t.description: video: the frame time of the closest line.

key.description: Catalog checks only: the @key without the @.

catalog.description: Catalog checks only: the file the key came from.

first_seen.description: video only: the first frame time the text was found.

last_seen.description: video only: the last frame time the text was found.

range.description: video only: the --expect range the check came from.

severity.description: How much a real defect of this kind hurts a user, fixed per kind and rule.

certainty.description: How likely a finding of this kind, from this reader, is a real defect, from its measured precision. Not confidence, which is how well a line was read.

precision.description: The measured precision certainty came from, 3 decimals; null when the band does not come from a precision (unmeasured, experimental, deterministic).

gate.description: True when the item counts toward the verdict and the exit code under the run's --min-severity and --min-certainty; a failed check always gates.

line.description: The recognized line (two joined lines for wrapped text). null only for a fit finding on a textless control.

key.description: untranslated: the catalog key, the first by sort order when several share the base text. raw-key: the catalog key the line was matched to, when exactly one. truncated pseudo-cut and hardcoded: the base catalog key.

keys.description: untranslated: every key with this base text, when there are several. raw-key: every candidate catalog key, when the line matches several.

catalog.description: untranslated: the target catalog file to fix.

base.description: untranslated: the base string as written.

expected.description: untranslated: the target string as written; null when the target has none. truncated: the full string (element text or catalog string), or null.

reason.description: truncated: the rule that fired. fit: wrapped or orphan (how a label breaks into rows), else the hardware zone that hides the line or control.

hidden.description: fit: the hidden characters in reading order; null for a control.

hidden_box.description: fit: the union of the hidden characters' boxes (the control's box for a control).

zone_box.description: fit: the bounding box of the zone that was hit, so a report draws it without the profile.

profile.description: fit: the device profile id the image was checked against; under device-ambiguous, the candidate ids joined by + (only pixels hidden on all of them were checked).

rows.description: fit wrapped and orphan: the element's rows on this screenshot.

base_rows.description: fit wrapped: the base element's rows (1) with evidence base; null otherwise.

base_path.description: fit wrapped: the base-locale screenshot of the same screen, with evidence base; null otherwise.

orphan.description: fit orphan: the last row, one word.

covered.description: fit: the share of a control's box under the zone, 2 decimals; null for text.

side.description: truncated pseudo-cut: the end of the string that is missing its marker.

lost.description: truncated pseudo-cut: filler, the base string fits but a longer translation will not; text, the base text itself is cut.

evidence.description: fit wrapped: declared (max_lines 1), base (one row in the base locale) or control (a one-line control's only label); null for orphan. hardcoded: base, the line equals a base catalog string (key, catalog and expected name it); none, it matches no catalog string. wrong-language: catalog, the line is another locale's string for a key (key, catalog, expected and evidence_catalog name it); langid, the language recognizer or the line's script.

language.description: wrong-language: the language the line is in, a project locale (or the recognizer's code). uncatalogued: the project locale the recognizer names at 0.95 or more, else null.

nearest.description: uncatalogued: the closest catalog string (normalized edit distance below 0.5), else null.

rule.description: format: number | date | time | currency-placement; currency: unexpected | mixed.

field.description: price: what disagrees with the price file.

product.description: price: the product the amount was bound to.

expected_currency.description: currency: the storefront's currency; null only for mixed without one.

evidence_catalog.description: wrong-language with catalog evidence: the other locale's file that holds the line.

traits.description: pseudo-not-applied: the share of lines with a pseudo trait, 2 decimals.

lines.description: pseudo-not-applied: the lines with letters it was judged on.

overflow.description: truncated overflow: line heights the line runs past its element's edge, 2 decimals.

element.description: truncated: the element the line was matched to, or null without boxes.

confidence.description: truncated: Vision's confidence for the line. fit: the line's, null for a control. wrong-language: the recognizer's probability, 1 for catalog or script evidence.

a.description: overlap: the upper (then left) line of the pair; with signal elements the text side, its box the element's ink; with signal stacked the line read without language correction.

b.description: overlap: the other line or element; null with signal stacked (one read).

stacked_evidence.description: overlap, signal stacked: correction-dropped, the corrected read dropped the line; correction-changed, it read the line as other text; dictionary, the production read is mostly words the macOS dictionaries do not know.

corrected.description: overlap, signal stacked: the production (corrected) read of the line's box; null when it dropped the line.

overlap.description: overlap: the intersection over the smaller box's area; occluded: the share of the text element's box under the panel.

signal.description: overlap: the reader that fired: boxes (OCR line geometry), elements (element boxes confirmed by ink), sheets (two text elements of one line height, one inside the other, confirmed by ink: sheets or pages drawn over each other) or stacked (text drawn over text, found by reading without language correction or as words no dictionary knows).

ratio.description: low-contrast, busy-background: the measured WCAG contrast ratio, 2 decimals.

threshold.description: low-contrast, busy-background: the WCAG threshold for the line's size and the run's level.

size.description: low-contrast, busy-background: the text size class from line height and device scale; uncertain is judged as large.

ink.description: low-contrast, busy-background: the text colour (sRGB) the ratio was measured with.

edges.description: low-contrast, busy-background: the edge share of the background under and around the line (busy above the threshold).

scale.description: low-contrast, busy-background: the device scale the size came from.

scale_source.description: low-contrast, busy-background: where the scale came from; none means scale 1 was assumed.

suggest.description: low-contrast: the nearest ink of the same hue that passes; null when none does.

expected_path.description: missing: the layout pattern filled in, without an extension.

severity.description: How much a real defect of this kind hurts a user, fixed per kind and rule.

certainty.description: How likely a finding of this kind, from this reader, is a real defect, from its measured precision. Not confidence, which is how well a line was read.

precision.description: The measured precision certainty came from, 3 decimals; null when the band does not come from a precision (unmeasured, experimental, deterministic).

gate.description: True when the item counts toward the verdict and the exit code under the run's --min-severity and --min-certainty; a failed check always gates.

known.description: With --known: true when the finding matches an approved row of the known file (it never gates), false when it is new. Absent without --known.

known_counts.description: A new finding (known false): how many findings of its key this input has, and how many the known file approves.
